topology: 16 nodes x4 H100, NVSHMEM star over the NIC with P2P disabled: ranks 1-63 push a full slot to rank 0, rank 0 answers each with slot/8
golden: none — assertions only, the same two case 16 runs at 4 ranks
workload_note: `asym_patterns hub 4096 3` at 64 PEs with NVSHMEM_DISABLE_P2P=1, so intra-node peers use the NIC too and every one of the 126 edges is verbs traffic. Not a suite case — 16 nodes is not something to spend on every board run — but it carries case 16's two assertions verbatim, by symlink, because both are closed-form in params.ranks and therefore say the same thing at 4 ranks and at 64. app_buffer_bytes is npes*slot*4 = 1 MiB, the hub's receive buffer, which is 16x case 16's and the point of the run: one object written by 63 distinct peers into 63 disjoint bands.
